compressor.note: The frozen capsule archives were produced by zstd 1.4.8, the build host's version. zstd does not promise identical output across releases: the same payload compressed with level 3 on a runner whose PATH resolves to a 1.5.x build differs while the payload is byte-identical either way. The prepare run therefore compresses with this recorded binary.

directory_mtimes.note: Union of the directory mtimes the dev capsules carry, taken from the capsules themselves. Extraction restores a directory mtime only from an entry in the same archive, so a directory that several capsules write into keeps the extraction time; the prepare run restores this record after extracting the tree.

packer.note: The dev capsules were all packed at freeze time with this revision; reproducing an archive requires the same revision plus --graph-index.
